propositions: Bridge must transition from continuous self-dispatch to hourly schedule (cron '23 * * * *') to free the runner, with RECONCILE_CONTINUOUS already flipped to false.

CloudWatch bridge_run_failures alarm is structurally unfirable at hourly cadence under its original tuning (threshold=1, evaluation_periods=1) because at most one pass lands per hour; must retune to threshold=0, evaluation_periods=2, datapoints_to_alarm=2 to detect sustained failures while remaining silent on single flakes.

Cadence test must derive fire times from workflow cron and assert uniform 60-minute gaps, exactly one schedule entry, and non-zero minute to prevent regression to multi-entry blocks or :00-minute drifts.

All 40-minute cadence references across workflows, tests, scripts, and docs must be updated to hourly (1-hour worst-case latency), except historical context explaining why the three-entry form existed.

Terraform apply is required to deploy the alarm threshold changes; terraform-drift.yml will fail on the infra/terraform/monitoring_bridge.tf diff and remain red until AWS credentials apply the change.
